architecture.horizontal_edges: requires signed station coordinate or physical adjacency manifest
architecture.head: small anchor-negative add-only anomaly head

semantic_audit.mstcn: MS-TCN uses temporal convolutions over row sequences, not fixed station-layer graph message passing.
semantic_audit.graph_derived_tabular: Existing adjacent-layer residuals are fixed tabular features, not a learned masked node encoder.
semantic_audit.group_dro: Group-DRO changes the loss weighting of MS-TCN and is not a graph architecture.
semantic_audit.event_classifiers: Existing logistic/CatBoost event heads score frozen proposals rather than learn causal station-layer node representations.

simpler_unused_candidate.name: shared_causal_station_layer_state_space_predictor
simpler_unused_candidate.description: One weight-shared causal linear state-space next-step predictor per station-layer with mask channels; no horizontal graph and no label fit in the representation.
